failures.question: We need to create a persistent table of all High Fidelity Mesh data for our archaeological analysis. Please set up a materialized view called 'high_fidelity_meshes'. The view should include the mesh's registry ID, site reference, equipment used, vertex and face counts, resolution in millimeters, geometric accuracy, and the calculated MCR value. Only include meshes that meet all the High Fidelity Mesh criteria.
failures.pred_sql: CREATE VIEW high_fidelity_meshes AS SELECT sm.facetregistry, sm.zoneref, sm.equipref, sm.facetverts, sm.facetfaces, sm.facetresmm, sm.geomdeltamm, ( CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL) / NULLIF(sm.facetverts, 0) / POWER(sm.facetresmm, 2) ) * 1000 AS mcr FROM scanmesh AS sm WHERE ( CAST(sm.facetfaces AS REAL) / NULLIF(sm.facetverts, 0) / POWER(sm.facetresmm, 2) ) * 1000 > 5.0 AND sm.facetresmm < 1.0 AND sm.geomdeltamm < 0.5

failures.question: Create a view called view_premium_quality_scans that identifies high-quality archaeological scans. This view should include the Scan ID, Project Reference, Site Reference, Scan Timestamp, Scan Resolution (mm), Point Density (points/m²), Coverage (%), Overlap (%), and Noise Level (dB). Please include all scans, even those that may not yet have associated point cloud data. The view should identify scans that meet the criteria for both a High Resolution Scan and Comprehensive Coverage, and also have a Noise Level less than 1.5.
failures.pred_sql: CREATE VIEW view_premium_quality_scans AS SELECT s.QuestRegistry, s.ArcRef, s.ZoneRef, s.ChronoTag, spc.ScanResolMm, spc.PointDense, spc.CoverPct, spc.LapPct, spc.NoiseDb FROM scans s LEFT JOIN scanpointcloud spc ON s.ArcRef = spc.ArcRef AND s.CrewRef = spc.CrewRef WHERE spc.ScanResolMm <= 1.0 AND spc.PointDense >= 1000 AND spc.CoverPct >= 95.0 AND spc.LapPct >= 30.0 AND spc.NoiseDb < 1.5;
failures.sol_sql: CREATE VIEW view_premium_quality_scans AS SELECT s.QuestRegistry, s.ArcRef, s.ZoneRef, s.ChronoTag, spc.ScanResolMm, spc.PointDense, spc.CoverPct, spc.LapPct, spc.NoiseDb FROM scans s LEFT JOIN scanpointcloud spc ON s.ArcRef = spc.ArcRef AND s.CrewRef = spc.CrewRef WHERE spc.ScanResolMm <= 1.0 AND spc.PointDense >= 1000 AND spc.CoverPct >= 95.0 AND spc.LapPct >= 30.0 AND spc.NoiseDb < 1.5;
